name: BBT
fix_description: setRegistry has no access control — anyone can change the registry address. Add onlyOwner or require(msg.sender == admin) check, consistent with how setMaxSupply is protected.
difficulty_reasoning: This is essentially a missing access control / trust-on-external-registry issue: the attacker deploys a fake registry contract, points the token to it via setRegistry, then mints arbitrary BBT and dumps it through Uniswap. The PoC is short, linear, and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic ERC20 mint-and-sell flow.
